notes: «جَمَاعَةُ مَشَايِخِي» is an unnamed group of shaykhs
«أَخِيهِ عَلِيٍّ» is one link, the name alone (rule 7)
the bracketed «[الْحُسَيْنِ]» is the editor's correction, kept in the surface as written
the Imam is named in the words after the chain («قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ») and is the last link (ruling 2); the Prophet's quotation in the report is not a link
